Quick note: the portal's 85.2 may only cover graded work so far, so treat this as an estimate.

I'll assume a B means 80% or higher. Check your syllabus for the cutoff.

If the final is 30% and the other 70% is already counted in your 85.2:
- Your earned points so far: 0.70 × 85.2 = 59.64
- You need 80 total, so 80 − 59.64 = 20.36 from the final
- 20.36 ÷ 0.30 = about 67.9%

**Minimum on the Dec 15 final: about 68%.** Call it 70% to be safe.

Caveat: if the portal's 85.2 doesn't yet include all the quizzes and lab work, the real number moves a bit. Re-run it once those are posted. Also, if your syllabus has a different B cutoff, tell me and I'll redo it.
ok but explain the weighting like rate and totes on the line. i remember stuff better that way

Think of the semester as a shift.

- Each category is a different dock with its own quota. Quizzes, practicals, lab work and the final are four docks, and the weight is how many totes each dock counts toward your shift total.
- The final is 30 of every 100 totes. That's the biggest single dock, but it's not the whole shift.
- You've already scanned about 70 totes at an 85.2 rate. That's banked, with 59.64 totes in the bin.
- Passing the B line means hitting 80 totes total. You're only short about 20.36.
- The final dock has 30 totes available. To close that gap you need to hit about 68% of them.

So you have a big cushion. You don't need a perfect rate, just a steady one. Anything above ~70% on the final keeps the B.
